confirmSlug.description: The salon's slug, typed exactly, to confirm an irreversible closure

Meta.description: What the running service says about itself.

commit.description: The commit the build was made from, or `unknown` when the build had no repository.

time.description: The server's time: an ISO-8601 instant in UTC.

version.description: The version the build was given.

expiresAt.description: When a support session (kind support) ends; null for every other kind

Problem.description: An error, as problem details (RFC 9457) with a stable machine-readable `code`.

code.description: The stable reason. Branch on this.

detail.description: A sentence for a person. Do not branch on it.

errors.description: For a request body that failed validation (`bad_request`): each field that failed, when the failure has a field. Never the value that was refused.

detail.description: What is wrong with it, for a person.

field.description: The field, as the request names it; a dotted path when nested.

title.description: A short summary of the status.

traceId.description: The request's trace id: the `trace.id` of its log lines and of its trace.

type.description: A URI identifying the kind of problem.

Salon.description: The public brand and published profile of the salon the request's hostname names.

cover.description: The published cover, served at `/api/v1/salon/brand/images/{id}`; null for none.

logo.description: The published logo, served at `/api/v1/salon/brand/images/{id}`; null for none.

profile.description: The salon's published business profile, exactly as last published; null before the first publication. A draft is never served here.

slug.description: The salon's slug: its subdomain on the platform domain.

tagline.description: The salon's published tagline; null when it has none.

timeZone.description: The salon's time zone, an IANA name. The salon's times are shown in it.

cover.description: The cover, a JPEG at most 1600 wide, or null for none (the neutral cover).

logo.description: The logo, a square PNG of at most 512 x 512, or null for none (the salon's initial).

hasUnpublishedChanges.description: Whether the draft differs from the published brand.

publishedAt.description: When the brand was last published from a draft; null when it never was.

publishedBy.description: The staff account that last published it; null when it never was.

version.description: The draft's version; the next change must send it, an older one is refused with `conflict`.

height.description: Its height in pixels, as kept.

width.description: Its width in pixels, as kept.

file.description: The image file: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

colour.description: `#RRGGBB`, in either case; kept in upper case.

cover.description: A cover image of this salon, or null for none.

logo.description: A logo image of this salon, or null for none.

tagline.description: Up to 80 characters; empty or null for none.

deleteAt.description: When a closed salon's data is deleted: 30 days after closure

deletedAt.description: When a closed salon's data was deleted

SalonProfile.description: A salon's business profile. Every field is optional: null when it is not set.

branches.description: Each branch's contact details, the default branch first. In R1 this holds exactly the default branch; a client must not assume it holds one.

description.example: A friendly neighbourhood salon for hair, beauty and bridal.

isDefault.description: Whether it is the salon's default branch.

location.description: The branch's map position, or null when it is not set.

phone.description: The branch's phone number in E.164; screens show it in the national format.

whatsapp.description: The salon's own WhatsApp number, a mobile number in E.164.

isDefault.description: Ignored: which branch is the default is not changed here. Accepted so that a profile the API answered can be sent back as it is.

location.description: Both coordinates, or null for none.

phone.description: A phone number of the configured region in any common form, such as `011 250 4417` or `+94112504417`.

whatsapp.description: A mobile number of the configured region in any common form, such as `077 412 3300`.

hasUnpublishedChanges.description: Whether the draft holds something customers do not see yet: a difference from the published profile, or, before the first publication, anything set at all.

publishedAt.description: When the profile was last published; null before the first publication.

publishedBy.description: The staff account that last published it; null before the first publication.

version.description: The draft's version. The next save, publication or discard must send it; an older one is refused with `conflict`.

branches.description: The branches whose details are set; a branch not listed keeps its draft. A branch id that is not the salon's is a field error.

currency.description: Required, and only allowed, when the salon has no currency of its own

notice.description: The workspace banner to show, decided by the API at the time of the request

entryCode.description: Single-use; exchanged once on the salon's host within 60 seconds

entryUrl.description: The salon's workspace support entry page with the code in its fragment

post.description: A PNG, JPEG or WebP image of up to 5 MB, told by its content, not its name or declared type. A logo is at least 128 x 128 and is kept as its centre square, a PNG of at most 512 x 512; a cover is at least 800 x 300 and is kept as a JPEG at most 1600 wide and 1600 high (a cover whose shape would keep it taller is refused). Both are re-encoded, so no metadata is kept. An image unused for 24 hours is removed.
